items.headline: Flood Watch issued July 15 at 1:05PM CDT until July 16 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
items.label: Alert
items.detail:
* WHAT...Flooding and flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall
continues to be possible.

* WHERE...A portion of south central Texas, including the following
counties, Bandera, Bexar, Blanco, Burnet, Comal, Dimmit, Edwards,
Frio, Gillespie, Guadalupe, Hays, Kendall, Kerr, Kinn
